Migration path, business case and operating model
CI/CD, Key Vault and event-driven architecture

takeaways: Fragile hero scripts become a hidden cost at scale; orchestration through Microsoft Graph subscriptions, Logic Apps and Azure Functions turns them into a shared, governed platform.
Reliability comes from pairing webhooks with daily delta-query reconciliation, using managed identities and Key Vault instead of stored credentials, and enforcing governance as code.
Migrate incrementally, run old and new automations in parallel, apply CI/CD with Git, Pester and pipelines, and build the identity and governance foundation that agents and Agent 365 will need.
hook: Many organizations drown in disconnected PowerShell scripts and Power Automate flows that break silently when their author leaves. This episode shows architects and automation teams how to move from fragile scripts to a governed Microsoft Graph platform with Logic Apps, Azure Functions, managed identities and reconciliation, ready for autonomous agents.
